content.title: Introduction to Sustainable Energy System Transformation

content.text:
Module 1 presents a comprehensive overview of the energy landscape, framed within the global development agenda. It defines and explores interconnected concepts of sustainable energy with global challenges such as climate change, fossil fuel dependency, energy poverty and disparities and opportunities, such as local development, economic growth and energy security.

This module also assesses progress towards achieving Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 7 while exploring SDG 7’s critical interlinkages with other SDGs. The module seeks to equip readers with approaches, methods and tools for SDG7 acceleration and innovation.

objectives.title: Understand the concept of sustainable energy and its link with sustainable development, as well as the critical paradoxes and dilemma at the core of our energy systems.
Identify opportunities for synergies presented by the intersection of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the Sustainable Energy-for-Development pathways.
Develop strategies for building effective partnerships and leverage approaches, methods and tools for accelerating the energy transition.
